 Tobias Harris (calf) ruled out Friday 
 by Nicholas Rodriguez | Spurs Correspondent | Fri, Oct 23rd 2026, 4:48am EDT 
 Tobias Harris has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Houston Rockets. ( NBA Injury Report ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Harris will have to wait to make his San Antonio Spurs debut, as he will miss the team's second game of the season while recovering from a left calf strain. His next opportunity to play comes Saturday against the Dallas Mavericks. With Harris sidelined, Dylan Harper is expected to remain in the starting lineup, while Julian Champagnie should continue to see significant minutes off the bench.
